headline.zh: 把想法，做成可以使用的项目。

bio.zh: 浙江大学 2023 级本科生，目前关注 AI Efficiency。这里收录我的开源项目和参与贡献的作品。
bio.en: Undergraduate at Zhejiang University, class of 2023, currently interested in AI Efficiency. A selection of my open-source projects and contributions.

zh.title: AIPM
zh.summary: 面向 AI 产品经理的现代知识 Wiki。
zh.background: 以结构化知识整理 AI 产品管理相关的学习内容，为学习和查阅提供入口。
zh.detail: 从公开知识出发，连接产品思考与 AI 实践。可以直接访问项目网站阅读，也可以在 GitHub 查看项目。

en.title: AIPM
en.summary: A modern knowledge wiki for AI product management.
en.background: Organizes AI product management learning material into a structured resource for reading and reference.
en.detail: Connect product thinking with AI practice. Explore the project website or view the source on GitHub.

zh.title: VideoNote-MCP
zh.summary: 把视频整理成文字与笔记的 MCP 工具。
zh.background: 将视频内容转化为更方便检索、整理和继续使用的文字资料。
zh.detail: 项目公开说明覆盖画面、弹幕与评论理解，支持主流平台、解耦工具以及多格式导出。运行方式与依赖请参见项目文档。

en.title: VideoNote-MCP
en.summary: A practical MCP server for turning videos into notes.
en.background: Turns video content into text that can be searched, organized and reused.
en.detail: The project describes support for video frames, on-screen comments and discussion, multiple platforms, decoupled tools and export formats. See its repository for setup and dependencies.

zh.title: Agentero
zh.summary: 为人与 Agent 协作而生的科研工作台。
zh.background: 围绕研究与论文管理，让人与 Agent 在同一个工作空间协作。
zh.detail: 我的公开个人主页将其列为参与贡献的项目。项目详情与使用方式可在官网和源码仓库查看。

en.title: Agentero
en.summary: A research workspace built for human–agent collaboration.
en.background: Brings research and paper management into a shared workspace for people and agents.
en.detail: Listed under contributions on my public profile. Visit the project website and repository for details and usage.

zh.title: Multica
zh.summary: 让人与 AI Agent 像团队成员一样共同工作。
zh.background: 以开源、可自托管的工作空间组织人与 AI 编程 Agent 的协作。
zh.detail: 我的公开个人主页将其列为参与贡献的项目。可以从官网了解产品，并在 GitHub 查看开源实现。

en.title: Multica
en.summary: An open-source workspace for humans and AI agents.
en.background: A self-hostable workspace that organizes collaboration with AI coding agents as teammates.
en.detail: Listed under contributions on my public profile. Explore the product website and its open-source implementation on GitHub.

zh.title: JobMap
zh.summary: 在地图上探索公司办公地点与招聘岗位。
zh.background: 将办公地点、岗位信息和 AI 搜索组织到地图界面中。
zh.detail: 公开 README 描述了基于 Next.js 与 PostGIS 的岗位地图。招聘目录通过经审核的数据源导入；仓库介绍标注仍在修复问题。

en.title: JobMap
en.summary: Explore company offices and job openings on a map.
en.background: Combines office locations, job listings and AI-assisted search in a map interface.
en.detail: The public README describes a Next.js and PostGIS job explorer with reviewed recruitment data imports. The repository description notes ongoing bug fixes.

zh.title: ocrsnip
zh.summary: macOS 菜单栏截图、文字识别与截图置顶工具。
zh.background: 通过快捷键框选屏幕区域，将识别文字放入剪贴板，或将截图置顶作为参考。
zh.detail: 使用 Swift、Apple Vision 和 ScreenCaptureKit，支持截图窗口拖动、缩放及应用内更新。安装说明和公开安装包见源码仓库。

en.title: ocrsnip
en.summary: A macOS menu bar utility for screenshots, OCR and pinned images.
en.background: Select a screen region with a shortcut, copy recognized text or pin the capture as a reference.
en.detail: Built with Swift, Apple Vision and ScreenCaptureKit, with movable and resizable pinned captures and in-app updates. Installation instructions and releases are available in the repository.

zh.title: BililiveRecorder GUI
zh.summary: 为录播姬官方 CLI 与 WebUI 提供 Tauri 桌面封装。
zh.background: 在桌面应用中分发和启动录播后端，并管理进程生命周期与更新。
zh.detail: 主窗口直接加载 BililiveRecorder 官方 CLI 内嵌的 WebUI。公开 README 记录了 macOS 验证与 Windows、Linux 的验证边界；录制核心和界面来自上游项目。

en.title: BililiveRecorder GUI
en.summary: A Tauri desktop wrapper for the official BililiveRecorder CLI and WebUI.
en.background: Packages and starts the recording backend while managing its lifecycle and desktop updates.
en.detail: The main window loads the WebUI embedded in the official CLI. The README records macOS validation and platform limitations. Recording functionality and the WebUI come from upstream BililiveRecorder.

zh.title: EPay Observer Android
zh.summary: 对接 epay-go 的 Android 收款通知观察器原型。
zh.background: 研究微信与支付宝收款通知的持久采集、签名上报及测试订单匹配。
zh.detail: 公开 README 记录了模拟器合成通知与隔离 New API 测试环境的闭环验证。真实微信、支付宝通知与真机兼容性尚未验证，生产自动匹配保持关闭。

en.title: EPay Observer Android
en.summary: An Android payment-notification observer prototype for epay-go.
en.background: Explores persistent notification capture, signed reporting and test-order matching for WeChat and Alipay notifications.
en.detail: The README reports a validated loop using synthetic emulator notifications and an isolated New API test environment. Real payment notifications and physical-device compatibility remain unverified; production automatic matching is disabled.

zh.title: Neptune Aircon Client
zh.summary: 查询与控制尼普顿空调的非官方 Python 客户端。
zh.background: 提供命令行入口，也可接入自建后端，查询设备状态与管理临时授权。
zh.detail: 项目提供温度、模式、风速、开关和授权续期接口。公开 README 分别说明已验证和未实测的能力；当前授权导入适配特定 Mac 微信遥控入口。

en.title: Neptune Aircon Client
en.summary: An unofficial Python client for Neptune air-conditioner queries and controls.
en.background: Provides a CLI and backend integration for device status and temporary authorization management.
en.detail: Includes temperature, mode, fan speed, power and authorization-renewal interfaces. The README distinguishes verified behavior from untested controls and documents the supported Mac WeChat authorization workflow.

zh.title: FanFan
zh.summary: macOS 温度监控与风扇控制工具的维护分支。
zh.background: 上游 hoobnn/fanfan 提供菜单栏温度监控与风扇调速。
zh.contribution: 公开分支包含恢复系统风扇控制失败后的重试修复。
zh.detail: 源码入口指向个人维护分支；公开提交可核验该修复。这里记录分支修改，不表示该修改已被上游接收。

en.title: FanFan
en.summary: A maintenance fork of a macOS temperature and fan-control utility.
en.background: Upstream hoobnn/fanfan provides menu bar temperature monitoring and fan controls.
en.contribution: The public fork includes a fix that retries failed restoration of system fan control.
en.detail: The source link points to the personal maintenance fork and its public commit history. This records fork changes without claiming upstream acceptance.

zh.title: epay-go
zh.summary: 扩展通知观察器协议与充值测试链路的支付网关维护分支。
zh.background: 基于 zengxiang1/epay-go 的 Go 支付系统进行维护。
zh.contribution: 公开分支记录了账本原子性与幂等修复、观察器签名校验、事件匹配及回调处理。
zh.detail: 源码入口保留个人维护分支，修改依据可在提交记录中查阅。相关通知自动充值验证使用隔离合成场景，不据此宣称真实收款已可用于生产。

en.title: epay-go
en.summary: A payment-gateway maintenance fork with observer protocol and recharge-test integration.
en.background: Maintains and extends the Go payment system from zengxiang1/epay-go.
en.contribution: Public commits record atomic and idempotent ledger fixes, signed observer validation, event matching and callback handling.
en.detail: The source link preserves the personal fork and its change history. Notification-based recharge validation uses isolated synthetic scenarios and does not establish production readiness for real payments.

zh.title: ARIS · 地学扩展
zh.summary: 为 ARIS 自动研究工作流补充地学技能与 QGIS 接入。
zh.background: 基于 wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep 的个人扩展分支。
zh.contribution: 公开分支包含地学技能、QGIS MCP、视觉审查循环与坐标参考规范相关修改。
zh.detail: 分支差异和公开提交记录可用于核验扩展范围；不将整个上游研究系统归为个人原创，也不表示这些修改已被上游合并。

en.title: ARIS · Geoscience extensions
en.summary: Geoscience skills and QGIS integration for ARIS research workflows.
en.contribution: Public fork changes include geoscience skills, QGIS MCP, visual review loops and coordinate-reference guidance.
en.detail: The fork comparison and public commits document the extension scope. This does not claim authorship of the upstream research system or upstream acceptance of the changes.

zh.title: 竖置硬盘电源挂架
zh.summary: 包含打印模型、设计源文件与装配动画的硬件资料包。
zh.background: 整理竖置硬盘、电源与挂架的装配关系和机械尺寸参考。
zh.detail: 公开仓库包含 STL、FreeCAD 和 Blender 文件，以及装配动画与硬盘尺寸参考。作为设计资料展示，具体打印与装配要求以仓库说明为准。

en.title: Vertical HDD Power Mount
en.summary: A hardware design bundle with printable models, source files and assembly animation.
en.background: Documents the mounting relationship between a vertical hard drive, power supply and bracket.
en.detail: The public repository contains STL, FreeCAD and Blender files, assembly animation and drive-dimension references. Refer to the repository for printing and assembly requirements.

zh.title: idea
zh.summary: 记录日常产品想法与个人上下文系统构想。
zh.background: 为尚待实现的产品想法保留公开讨论与整理入口。
zh.detail: README 列出 HealthContext 与 PersonalContextOS 两项构想。这里作为创意资料收录，不将想法描述为已交付产品。

en.title: idea
en.summary: Product ideas and concepts for personal context systems.
en.background: A public place to collect and discuss ideas awaiting implementation.
en.detail: The README lists HealthContext and PersonalContextOS. These are presented as concept materials rather than delivered products.

zh.title: AGENTS.md
zh.summary: 面向个人开发流程定制的 Agent 协作约定。
zh.background: 基于 Da1sypetals/AGENTS.md 整理个人协作与代码修改要求。
zh.detail: 公开分支含个人约束修改。按文档与配置资料归入其他，保留上游来源，不将其作为独立软件产品。

en.title: AGENTS.md
en.summary: Agent collaboration guidelines customized for a personal development workflow.
en.background: Adapts Da1sypetals/AGENTS.md into personal collaboration and coding conventions.
en.detail: The public fork includes custom restrictions. It is classified as documentation and configuration material with upstream attribution.

zh.title: GitHub Stats
zh.summary: 用于个人主页的 GitHub 统计图片配置。
zh.background: 基于 jstrieb/github-stats 生成个人 GitHub 活动与语言统计图片。
zh.detail: README 明确指向上游 GitHub Stats Visualization，并展示个人生成结果。作为个人展示配置收录，保留原项目署名，不主张统计生成器为个人原创。

en.title: GitHub Stats
en.summary: GitHub statistics image configuration for a personal profile.
en.background: Uses jstrieb/github-stats to generate personal activity and language visualizations.
en.detail: The README credits upstream GitHub Stats Visualization and shows personalized output. This entry represents profile configuration and does not claim authorship of the statistics generator.
